benefits.name: Resy Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 in statement credits Jan-Jun and up to $50 Jul-Dec (total $100/year) on eligible Resy purchases. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 statement credit per month (total $120/year) at Grubhub/Seamless, The Cheesecake Factory, Goldbelly, Wine.com, and Five Guys. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.description: $10 Uber Cash each month (total $120/year). Monthly Uber Cash expires at 11:59 PM Hawaii time on the last day of each month.

benefits.name: Dunkin' Credit
benefits.description: Up to $7 statement credit per month (total $84/year) on eligible Dunkin' purchases at U.S. Dunkin' locations. Enrollment required.

multipliers.notes: Booked directly with airlines or Amex Travel
